frames.title: Pickaxe ready
frames.description: Front-right, beside a low isolated rock face fragment on ground. Both hands hold pickaxe raised over right shoulder, knees bent, ready to mine. Long dark hair, helmet, ochre tunic, NO beard.

frames.title: Pickaxe contact
frames.description: Same front-right view and rock fragment. Pickaxe lowered with metal point contacting stone, torso leaned forward, no motion blur.

frames.title: Shovel ore
frames.description: Left-side view, shoveling loose ore from a small ground pile into a wooden ore tub.

frames.title: Examine sample
frames.description: Front-left, crouching by a low wooden sorting tray examining a mineral sample held up in one hand, other hand on tray.

frames.title: Push ore barrow
frames.description: Rear-right three-quarter, pushing a small single-wheel wooden barrow partly filled with ore, whole barrow and boots visible.

frames.title: Repair pickaxe
frames.description: Front-right, seated at a low bench checking and tightening the head of a pickaxe with a small hammer, helmet kept on.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
